enum.name: MABUR_CAL_KIND
enum.description: Which calibration sweep a MABUR_CAL_SWEEP frame runs.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_KIND_WALL
entry.description: TX-power wall measurement, made by the drone on one channel and width.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_KIND_CAPACITY
entry.description: Link-capacity dwell sweep.

enum.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT
enum.description: Why MABUR_CAL_ACK accepted or refused a MABUR_CAL_SWEEP.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_ACCEPTED
entry.description: The drone will start the sweep.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_ANCHOR_UNREADABLE
entry.description: The drone has no readable calibration anchor: the chip did not report its TXAGC reference, or would not zero its rate diffs for a clean read.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_BUSY
entry.description: The drone is already running a sweep.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED
entry.description: The requested sweep is not supported by this drone build or its radio chip.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_BAD_CHANNEL
entry.description: The wall sweep's channel is not one of the drone's radio.channels.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_BAD_WIDTH
entry.description: A 40 MHz wall sweep on a drone whose radio is tuned to 20 MHz.

enum.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT
enum.description: How a wall sweep ended, in MABUR_CAL_SWEEP_DONE.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_OK
entry.description: A valid measurement; the walls are stored.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_UNPARKED
entry.description: The listener did not see the parked power level change.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_TOO_FEW_POINTS
entry.description: Too few power steps produced a value.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_FLOOR_TOO_HIGH
entry.description: The best EVM is above the floor a valid curve reaches.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_NOT_SATURATED
entry.description: The curve never rises into compression.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_DEADLINE
entry.description: The measurement ran out of time.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_DEVICE_ERROR
entry.description: The radio refused a step of the measurement.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_ABORTED
entry.description: The measurement was cancelled.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_WALL_RESULT_DISTURBED
entry.description: The curve falls back after rising: a capture held something else on the air.

enum.name: MABUR_UPDATE_CMD
enum.description: What a MABUR_UPDATE frame asks. Frozen: never change; add only extension fields.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_CMD_STATUS
entry.description: Report the update status.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_CMD_START
entry.description: Install the uploaded binary with the given SHA-256 and start the trial.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_CMD_ABORT
entry.description: Abandon the update in progress.

enum.name: MABUR_UPDATE_STATE
enum.description: State reported by MABUR_UPDATE_STATUS. Frozen: never change; add only extension fields.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_STATE_IDLE
entry.description: No update in progress.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_STATE_RECEIVING
entry.description: A binary is being received.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_STATE_TRIAL
entry.description: The new binary is on trial.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_STATE_COMMITTED
entry.description: The new binary was proven and kept.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_STATE_ROLLED_BACK
entry.description: The trial failed and the previous binary is back.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_STATE_REFUSED
entry.description: The update was refused; see reason.

enum.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON
enum.description: Why an update was refused or rolled back. Frozen: never change; add only extension fields.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_NONE
entry.description: No reason.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_EXITED
entry.description: The trial process exited.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_NO_LINK
entry.description: The trial never linked.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_NO_VIDEO
entry.description: The trial linked but produced no video.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_BAD_HASH
entry.description: The uploaded binary does not match the SHA-256.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_WRONG_BOARD
entry.description: The binary is not for this board.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_BAD_CONFIG
entry.description: The configuration was rejected.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_BUSY
entry.description: A trial is already running.

entry.name: MABUR_UPDATE_REASON_NO_FILE
entry.description: No uploaded binary to install.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_SWEEP
message.description: Ground asks the drone to run a calibration sweep.
message.field: Session nonce; the drone echoes it on every reply for this sweep.
The sweep's position in the run; the drone is idempotent by (nonce, seq).
Which sweep to run.
Channel bandwidth (MHz) the sweep flies at.
Wall sweep: the channel to measure; 0 = the link's channel.
Capacity sweep: settle time before each point, in milliseconds.
Capacity sweep: dwell time per point, in milliseconds.
Capacity sweep: bitmask of MCS indices probed.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK
message.description: Drone's reply to MABUR_CAL_SWEEP: accept, refuse, or report when the sweep will start.
message.field: Echoes the sweep's nonce.
Echoes the sweep's seq.
Accept/refuse result.
Milliseconds until the sweep starts, if accepted.
Stamp flag mask (LDPC, STBC) the drone flies for this sweep.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_SWEEP_DONE
message.description: Drone reports a finished sweep's results: per rate for a capacity sweep, the measured walls for a wall sweep.
message.field: Echoes the sweep's nonce.
Echoes the sweep's seq.
Capacity: frames offered per rate.
Capacity: per rate, the share of the dwell (percent) the drone's sender spent blocked on the device.
Wall: how the measurement ended.
Wall: the channel measured.
Wall: the bandwidth (MHz) measured.
Wall: per MCS, the wall as a TXAGC index relative to anchor; 63 = no wall found.
Wall: the best EVM of the curve, in 0.1 dB.
Wall: the chip's TXAGC reference index on the channel measured.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_APPLY
message.description: Ground pushes the efficiency table a capacity sweep produced for the drone to adopt.
message.field: Session nonce for this apply.
Seq of the sweep that produced this table.
Channel bandwidth (MHz) the table applies to.
air_clock efficiency per MCS, x1000; 0 = leave.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_APPLIED
message.description: Drone reports whether it adopted a MABUR_CAL_APPLY table.
message.field: Echoes the apply's nonce.
Echoes the apply's sweep seq.
Echoes the bandwidth the apply targeted.
1 if the table was adopted, 0 otherwise.
Why the drone refused; empty on success.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_ABORT
message.description: Ground cancels the in-progress sweep identified by nonce.
message.field: Nonce of the sweep to cancel.

message.name: MABUR_IDENT_REQ
message.description: Ground asks the drone to identify itself. Frozen: never change; add only extension fields.
message.field: Unused; MAVLink needs one field.

message.name: MABUR_IDENT
message.description: Drone identity. Frozen: never change; add only extension fields.
message.field: Build version.
Board name.
Radio chip name.

message.name: MABUR_UPDATE
message.description: Ground update command. Frozen: never change; add only extension fields.
message.field: Command.
SHA-256 of the uploaded binary (START).

message.name: MABUR_UPDATE_STATUS
message.description: Drone update status. Frozen: never change; add only extension fields.
message.field: Update state.
Reason for refused or rolled back.
Seconds left in the trial.
